evidence: community.tsx FeedPageRoute (:21-41) is mounted on the live route '/community' (traced: routes/AppRoutes.tsx:19 imports communityRoutes, :51 renders it; community.tsx:206 maps '/community' -> <FeedPageRoute/>). The wrapper passes posts={[]} and total={0} hardcoded with no useQuery/data fetch, and wires EVERY action callback to an empty no-op: onCreatePost={() => {}}, onLikePost, onCommentPost, onSharePost, onEditPost, onDeletePost, onFilterChange, onLoadMore (:26-38).

FeedPage's contract expects real behaviour: features/community/pages/FeedPage.tsx declares posts: CommunityPost[] (:14) and onCreatePost: (data: CreatePostRequest) => void (:23), and the in-page create-post form submits via onSubmit={onCreatePost} (:110). Because onCreatePost is () => {}, a resident who fills in and submits a new community post has their input silently discarded — no API call, no error, no toast. The feed itself is permanently empty (posts=[]) with no fetch.

Fix (frontend-only, cloud-landable): wire FeedPageRoute to the Community API hooks (useFeed/useCreatePost/useLikePost/... from @ppt/api-client, mirroring the data-wired GroupDetailPageInner pattern already in this same file :91-153) so posts are fetched and onCreatePost persists. Silent loss of user-authored content on a shipped route = high severity.

Three more live community routes render hardcoded-empty data with no backend wiring: GroupsPageRoute (:43-57) passes groups={[]} total={0}; EventsPageRoute (:166-182) passes events={[]} total={0}; MarketplacePageRoute (:184-200) passes items={[]} total={0}. All are mounted via communityRoutes() in AppRoutes.tsx:51 (paths '/community/groups', '/community/events', '/community/marketplace').

None of the three fetch data (no useQuery / @ppt/api-client list hook) and their action/filter handlers are all no-ops: onJoinGroup/onLeaveGroup/onFilterChange, onRsvp/onEditEvent/onDeleteEvent/onExportCalendar, onContactSeller/onEditItem/onDeleteItem/onMarkSold/onFilterChange. Each page therefore shows a permanent empty state and every button does nothing — shipped non-functional UI for Epic 42 community features.

Contrast: the same file's GroupDetailPageInner (:91-153) IS correctly data-wired (useGroup/useGroupMembers/useJoinGroup/useLeaveGroup with loading + not-found states). Fix: apply that pattern to the three list routes (fetch list data, wire join/rsvp/contact/filter handlers). Frontend-only, cloud-landable.

GroupDetailPageInner (:91-153, live at '/community/groups/:groupId') reads data correctly but wires its destructive/admin mutations to no-ops. onDelete={() => navigate('/community/groups')} (:146) navigates AWAY as if the group were deleted but never calls any delete mutation — the group still exists; the manager is misled into thinking the delete succeeded. No useDeleteGroup hook is imported (only useJoinGroup/useLeaveGroup are, :7).

Likewise onEdit (:145), onNavigateToSettings (:147), onPromoteMember (:148), onRemoveMember (:149), onBanMember (:150) are all () => {} — the group-admin UI (promote/remove/ban/settings) renders but performs nothing.

Fix (frontend-only, cloud-landable): import and call the corresponding Community API mutations (useDeleteGroup, usePromoteMember, useRemoveMember, useBanMember, etc.) and gate navigation on mutation success with a confirm + toast; at minimum onDelete must invoke an actual delete before navigating. Misleading destructive action on a shipped route.
